neighbours.label: Living or staying somewhere: ' live', ' lived', ' living (space)', ' stay', and Chinese/Korean 住/居住/숙박 'reside, lodge'; the same subjects with other verbs (work, study) stay quiet.
fire: After the flood the family had to live with relatives.
Most of the miners lived in small huts near the pit.
The flat has a bright living area and two bedrooms.
We stayed in a guesthouse near the harbour.
Her grandparents still live on the farm.
Students in the program share living quarters.
很多工人住在工厂附近的宿舍里。
He lived alone in a cabin for ten years.
quiet: After the flood the family had to borrow money from relatives.
Most of the miners worked in the deep pit near the river.
The flat has a bright kitchen and a small balcony.
We ate lunch in a café near the harbour.
Her grandparents still farm the land.
Students in the program share lecture notes.
很多工人在工厂附近的食堂吃饭。
He worked alone in a workshop for ten years.

notes: Card: peaks on ' living' x4, ' live' x3, ' lod' x3, ' lived' x2, ' sleeping' x2, 住, 숙박, 临时(居住); output (reversed) favours ' quarters', ' temporary', ' elsewhere'. Exploratory probe: living space 1.02, lived 0.74, live in tents 0.81, 住处 0.69, stay 0.28; worked/lecture notes 0.01-0.02.
